groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.654% and the 10Y at 4.904%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -1.62% over five sessions and -3.62% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -0.09% at about $89.29, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (+7/100, 61% confidence, improving ↑). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, healthy market breadth, supportive options positioning on the supportive side versus semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
